We have mass spec data: m/z 268.1939 (intensity 100) as base peak. Likely molecular ion [M+H]+? Usually ESI positive gives M+H. So molecular weight ~267.1939? Actually if m/z 268.19 is M+H, then neutral mass = 267.186? Wait subtract 1.0073 => 267.1866. So molecular weight ~267.19. Need to propose SMILES.

We need more data: maybe NMR, IR. Let's get carbon NMR.
